title: anthyllis vulneraria subproles variegata
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subproles variegata, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Marsh Clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis vulneraria subproles variegata include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
